name: Mothballs
source:
Even most seemingly insignificant of things may carry the heaviest of memories. Mothballs explores the concept of losing and finding, both physically and emotionally. Delve into our protagonist's memories and piece together the events that have led her to where we begin, sitting in a tiny, dark closet (how ironic).

[From [url=https://floraltine.itch.io/mothballs]itch.io[/url]]
